projects.project_name: GTC: CAMDEN INDUSTRIAL PARK 230/115KV NEW SUBSTATION
uncertainties: Document contains Critical Energy Infrastructure Information (CEII) and confidential notices; financial and supporting statement details are redacted.
The project primarily constructs the Camden Industrial Park 230/115kV substation, but also includes building a new 115kV line to Kinlaw substation.

evidence.text:
GTC: CAMDEN INDUSTRIAL PARK 230/115KV NEW SUBSTATION
Teams # 20342
Need Date 06/01/2025 Start Date 01/01/2024

GTC will construct a new 230/115kV substation with a three element 230kV ring bus, two element 115kV ring bus, and one new 230/115kV 400MVA transformer. A new 115kV line to Kinlaw substation will be built also.

projects.project_name: GTC: EATONTON PRIMARY - LICK CREEK 115KV LINE SWITCH REPLACEMENT
uncertainties: Document contains Critical Energy Infrastructure Information (CEII) and confidential notices; financial and supporting statement details are redacted.
The project is a switch replacement on the Eatonton Primary - Lick Creek 115kV section of the Eatonton Primary - Lake Oconee 115kV Line.

evidence.text:
GTC: EATONTON PRIMARY - LICK CREEK 115KV LINE SWITCH REPLACEMENT
Teams # 20590
Need Date 06/01/2025 Start Date 12/01/2023

Replace a 1200A RLB line switch on the Eatonton - Lake Oconee 115kV line with a with motor operator and SCADA controls. This switch is located on GTC's Eatonton Primary - Lick Creek 115kV section of the Eatonton Primary - Lake Oconee 115kV Line.

evidence.text:
JESUP - LUDOWICI PRIMARY 115KV REBUILD
Teams # 11821
Need Date 06/01/2025 Start Date 06/01/2023
Rebuild approximately 7.5 miles of the Jesup - North Jesup - Rayonier section of the Jesup - Ludowici Primary 115kV line from 100C 336.4 ACSR Linnet conductor to 100C 795 ACSR Drake conductor.
